0.headline: Foodlink F&B Holdings IPO GMP at 6% ahead of November 26 issue opening; check price band, timeline and other key details
0.heading: Foodlink F&B Holdings IPO GMP at 6% ahead of November 26 issue opening; check price band, timeline and other key details
0.intro: The grey market premium (GMP) of Foodlink F&B Holdings' upcoming initial public offering (IPO) stood at around 6 percent on November 23, indicating a modest premium ahead of the issue's opening later this week.
0.body:
The grey market premium (GMP) of Foodlink F&amp;B Holdings' upcoming initial public offering (IPO) stood at around 6 percent on November 23, indicating a modest premium ahead of the issue's opening later this week.

According to IPO tracking platform InvestorGain, Foodlink F&amp;B Holdings (India) shares were commanding a grey market premium of Rs 12 against the upper end of the IPO price band, translating into a premium of 6.3 percent.

However, the grey market premium is an unofficial indicator of investor sentiment and does not guarantee listing gains. It can change depending on market conditions and demand for the IPO.

Read Also: Mahanadi Coalfields IPO fully subscribed on last day of bidding; check latest GMP

The IPO of the luxury food services company will open for subscription on November 26. The company has fixed the price band at Rs 181-191 per equity share and is looking to raise around Rs 361 crore through the public offering.

The bidding window for the IPO will remain open from November 26 to November 30. The anchor investor bidding will take place on November 25.

The basis of allotment is expected to be finalised on December 1, while the initiation of refunds and credit of shares to eligible investors' demat accounts are scheduled for December 2.

Foodlink F&amp;B Holdings is expected to list on the BSE and the National Stock Exchange (NSE) on December 3.

At the upper end of the price band, the IPO is valued at Rs 360.76 crore. The issue comprises a fresh issue of shares worth Rs 192 crore and an offer for sale (OFS) of 88.35 lakh equity shares by the promoter and existing shareholders.

While the company will receive the proceeds from the fresh issue, the money raised through the OFS will go to the selling shareholders.

According to the red herring prospectus (RHP), Foodlink intends to utilise the fresh issue proceeds to expand its operations and pare down debt.

Of the total proceeds, Rs 21.40 crore has been earmarked for setting up a new centralised kitchen, while Rs 41.50 crore will be used to establish two new banquet facilities.

Check IPO News Here

The company also plans to invest Rs 50.81 crore in its material subsidiary, Foodlink Global Restaurants &amp; Catering Services LLC, to finance the establishment of four casual dining restaurants.

Further, Rs 21 crore will be allocated towards the repayment or prepayment of certain outstanding borrowings availed by the company and its subsidiary. The remaining funds will be used for general corporate purposes.

Equirus Capital and JM Financial are the book-running lead managers for the issue, while MUFG Intime India has been appointed as the registrar.

About Foodlink F&amp;B Holdings

Foodlink F&amp;B Holdings operates in the luxury food services segment, offering curated culinary experiences through three key business verticals: events catering, casual dining restaurants and cloud kitchens, and banquets and integrated food and beverage services.

Its restaurant portfolio includes brands such as China Bistro, India Bistro, Glocal and Art of Dum, with operations across India and the UAE.

1.headline: Watrana Rentals IPO GMP nears 20%; issue subscribed over 50x so far on Day 3
1.heading: Watrana Rentals IPO GMP nears 20%; issue subscribed over 50x so far on Day 3
1.intro: The initial public offering (IPO) of Watrana Rentals is set to close for subscription on November 23, with the issue receiving over 50 times subscription, as per NSE data.
1.body:
The initial public offering (IPO) of Watrana Rentals is set to close for subscription on November 23, with the issue receiving over 50 times subscription, as per NSE data.

As of 12:48 pm on November 23, the Rs 120.10-crore IPO was subscribed 52.23 times. Investors had placed bids for 1.70 crore shares against 32.64 lakh shares on offer.

The non-institutional investors (NII) category led the demand, with its portion subscribed 100.25 times. The retail investor segment was subscribed 52.15 times, while the qualified institutional buyers (QIB) portion received bids 16.55 times the shares reserved for the category.

In the grey market, Watrana Rentals shares were commanding a premium of Rs 55 per share, translating into a GMP of around 18.37 percent over the upper end of the IPO price band of Rs 245, according to InvestorGain. However, GMP is an unofficial indicator of market sentiment and does not guarantee listing gains.

Read Also: Mahanadi Coalfields IPO subscribed 50% so far on last day of bidding; check latest GMP

The company opened its IPO for subscription on November 19 and has fixed the price band at Rs 232-245 per share. The issue comprises a fresh issue of 49.02 lakh equity shares aggregating to Rs 120.10 crore, with no offer-for-sale component.

The lot size is 600 shares, and investors are required to apply for a minimum of two lots. At the upper end of the price band, the minimum investment works out to Rs 2.94 lakh.

The allotment is expected to be finalised on November 25, while the shares are tentatively scheduled to list on the NSE Emerge platform on November 27.

Check IPO News Here

About Watrana Rentals

Incorporated in 2019, Watrana Rentals provides rental solutions for material handling equipment, including forklifts, reach trucks and powered pallet trucks. Its equipment is used across industries for material movement and handling requirements.

2.headline: Foodlink F&B Holdings fixes price band at Rs 181-191 per share for Rs 361-crore IPO, issue opens November 26
2.heading: Foodlink F&B Holdings fixes price band at Rs 181-191 per share for Rs 361-crore IPO, issue opens November 26
2.intro: Foodlink F&B Holdings (India) Ltd has fixed the price band for its upcoming initial public offering (IPO) at Rs 181-191 per equity share.
2.body:
Foodlink F&amp;B Holdings (India) Ltd has fixed the price band for its upcoming initial public offering (IPO) at Rs 181-191 per equity share. The luxury food services company aims to raise approximately Rs 361 crore through the public issue, which will open for subscription on November 26.

The bidding for anchor investors will take place on November 25, a day before the issue opens for retail and other investors. The IPO will close on November 30.

At the upper end of the price band, the issue is valued at Rs 360.76 crore. It comprises a fresh issue of equity shares worth Rs 192 crore and an offer for sale (OFS) of 88.35 lakh shares by the promoter and existing shareholders.

Read Also: From selling spices to Rs 70,000-crore jewellery business: How Kerala's MP Ahammed turned failure into Malabar Gold &amp; Diamonds

Through the OFS, existing shareholders will sell part of their stake in the company, while the proceeds from the fresh issue will go to Foodlink F&amp;B Holdings.

According to the Red Herring Prospectus (RHP), Foodlink plans to use the proceeds from the fresh issue to expand its food services business and reduce debt.

The company has earmarked Rs 21.40 crore for setting up a new centralised kitchen and Rs 41.50 crore for establishing two new banquets.

It will invest another Rs 50.81 crore in its material subsidiary, Foodlink Global Restaurants &amp; Catering Services LLC, to fund the establishment of four new casual dining restaurants.

Additionally, Rs 21 crore will be used for the repayment or prepayment of certain outstanding borrowings availed by the company and its subsidiary. The remaining proceeds will be allocated towards general corporate purposes.

The public issue will close on November 30. The basis of allotment is expected to be finalised on December 1, while refunds and credit of shares to demat accounts are scheduled for December 2.

Check IPO News Here

Foodlink F&amp;B Holdings is expected to make its stock market debut on December 3. Its shares are proposed to be listed on the BSE and the National Stock Exchange (NSE).

Equirus Capital and JM Financial are the book-running lead managers for the IPO, while MUFG Intime India is the registrar to the issue.

About Foodlink F&amp;B Holdings

Foodlink F&amp;B Holdings is a luxury food services company focused on providing curated culinary experiences. Its business operations are spread across three segments: events catering, casual dining restaurants and cloud kitchens, and banquets and integrated food and beverage services.

The company operates casual dining restaurants under brands such as China Bistro, India Bistro, Glocal and Art of Dum across India and the UAE.

Its events catering business caters to weddings, corporate events, sports events and other social gatherings. The company also operates banquets under its Jade brand.
